column2: agreed merge:diagnóstico, but unaccented diagnostico is also 1sg present of diagnosticar (yo diagnostico): check which reading the forms carry; merge:diagnosticar may fit part
agreed merge:décima, but decima is also 3sg present of diezmar/decimar (decima = decimates): a second real word under the accent merge
agreed merge:sangría for a cut-off fragment; sangr- is also the stem of sangre and sangrar: confirm the forms really are sangría
agreed merge:pío, but most occurrences are the name Pío/Pio (Pío XII) and PIO; check whether the common word is a minority (the minority rule would drop)
agreed drop, but Satán (with accent) is a Spanish word; check whether this is a missing-accent form that should merge rather than an English name
agreed drop as a name, but prez is a real Spanish noun (honour) and its plural preces (prayers) is filed here: second real word
agreed drop, but mistica is a missing-accent form of the common word mística; check whether the project-name reading really dominates
agreed keep, but FFAA is an abbreviation of fuerzas armadas (an abbreviation of a listed word merges): merge:fuerzas armadas may fit
agreed keep as an acronym, but GLBT is a variant order of LGBT; merge:LGBT may fit (reviewers both raised it)
